definitions.explanation: Introduces what will happen if the action just mentioned is not taken. The formal, written counterpart of さもないと, common in notices, instructions, and literary prose.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦{出|で}→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。さもなければ⟦{遅|おく}れます→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: Leave now. Otherwise you will be late.

examples.japanese: {期日|きじつ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{支払|しはら}って→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。さもなければ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{解除|かいじょ}→解除：05762_kaijo⟧⟦されます→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Please pay by the due date. Otherwise the contract will be terminated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦そのもの→そのもの：27432_sonomono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。さもなければ、⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}される→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧だろう。
examples.english: The system itself needs to be reviewed. Otherwise, the same problem will be repeated again and again.

notes:
さ (so) + ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ + ⟦なければ→ない：01118_nai⟧ (the conditional of ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧): literally "if it is not so."

COMMON PATTERNS:
[instruction or requirement]。さもなければ [unwanted consequence]。

REGISTER:
Formal and written. In speech, ⟦さもないと→さもないと：06942_samonaito⟧ sounds dramatic but natural, while ⟦そうしないと→そうしないと：30682_soushinaito⟧ and ⟦じゃないと→じゃないと：30683_janaito⟧ are the everyday choices. さもなければ appears mostly in official notices, contracts, and translated literature.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦さもないと→さもないと：06942_samonaito⟧: the same meaning, slightly less formal
- でなければ: if not — attaches to a noun or clause rather than standing alone
- ⟦そうしないと→そうしないと：30682_soushinaito⟧: if you don't do that — neutral and conversational
